text:
casey: AUS-west keystore-proxy started returning 503s ~11:05 UTC; ~40% of GPU warm-pool failed onboarding. seeing `keystore-proxy: rate_limit` and nodes stuck in 'decrypting' state.

maria: paste minimal logs?

casey: ```
keystore-proxy[pid=23]: WARN 503 rate_limit qps=1280 target=1000
2026-03-23T11:05:12Z keystore: decrypt failed: upstream 503
node-init: decrypt loop retrying...
```

aj: this the sharded keystore endpoint or the regional aggregator?

casey: sharded. az-affinity is set to prefer local keystore; fallback was disabled by policy during audit-rollout.

sasha: we disabled cross-AZ fallback in the last rollout to reduce audit blast — side-effect is no resiliency if local keystore flaps. @priya-devsec we need security triage if we enable fallback temporarily.

infra-bot: alert: keystore-proxy qps breach detected in region aus-west. current_qps=1325 threshold=1200

maria: short-term options: 1) re-enable cross-AZ fallback so nodes can talk to aus-east keystore (latency hit) 2) whitelist NAT egress for warm-pool nodes to hit aggregator (cost hit) 3) reduce audit sampling to lower load.

aj: option 2 increases NAT egress — rough estimate +$1.8k/day if warm-pool stays inefficient. option 1 needs infra change + security ok for cross-region key access.

priya-devsec: we can approve a scoped KMS grant for `keystore:Decrypt` limited to the warm-pool IAM principal with a 4h TTL. audit log retention will spike; need ops to capture retention delta.

casey: if we re-enable fallback, patch node-init to prefer fallback only after N retries so we avoid extra latency for healthy nodes.

maria: propose immediate mitigation: apply scoped KMS grant + re-enable fallback only for aus-west warm-pool; open runbook to revert after warm-pool stabilizes. i'll own rollback.

aj: ack. i'll run the cost calc and open infra PR for the temporary NAT/route change. ETA 30m.

priya-devsec: :thumbsup: queuing the IAM grant with 4h expiry now. i'll also request temporary audit sampling at 50% for the window.

infra-bot: runbook created: RB-7288887777-1 keystore-fallback-temporary (owner: maria)

casey: nodes are starting to finish onboarding (+6 in last 2m). watching queues.

maria: follow-up action: schedule a postmortem to decide if the fallback policy should have an SLA-based override knob (so production warm-pools don't stall).

sasha: agreed — postmortem + policy proposal. thanks all for quick triage. :heart:
